entries.what: Round-1 selection on dev folds, pipeline frozen and committed, Sep-Oct evaluated once (v1).

After seeing the v1 Sep-Oct under-prediction: exploratory dev-fold-only experiments (linear trend, recency weighting). Neither met the adoption rule; pipeline unchanged. Sep-Oct is therefore not independent evidence for anything decided from this point on.

External code review found the inner early-stopping month was contaminated: preprocessing and the residual filter were fitted on the whole training window (including the early-stopping month) and early-stopping rows were filtered; the filter also used in-sample rather than out-of-fold residuals. Fixed; dev selection, freeze and Sep-Oct evaluation re-run with unchanged rules. Pre-fix outputs archived in reports/history/.
